Company Privacy Policy

This document outlines how we handle user data.

1. Data Collection
We collect only the information necessary to provide our services.
All data is stored securely and access is restricted to authorized personnel.

2. Data Usage
User data is used solely to improve our services and user experience.
We do not sell or share user data with third parties without explicit consent.

3. Data Retention
We retain user data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.
Users may request deletion of their data at any time.

4. Security
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect user data.
Regular security audits are conducted to ensure compliance.

5. Contact
For questions about this policy, please contact privacy@company.com.
